CustomField.description: BR-15, PD-17, PD-18. THE SELLER INPUT recording why a pursuit was lost: selecting a value IS the act of recording the loss, so no companion checkbox exists. RESTRICTED picklist - Salesforce refuses any value outside the governed vocabulary before a validation rule or the assessment sees it, so membership is never re-tested elsewhere. Each value routes to a different upstream owner: Not ICP feeds targeting and MQL qualification, Product Gap feeds product management, Lost to Competitor feeds competitive response, No Decision feeds qualification discipline. NO Other and NO Price - PD-18 records why each is excluded, and why neither exclusion is a universal claim. NOT universally required at the field layer: the requirement is conditional on entering Closed Lost. Salesforce stays authoritative on WHETHER the Opportunity is lost; this field governs only WHY.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why this Opportunity was lost. Required when the stage becomes Closed Lost.
CustomField.label: Loss Reason
